readings.Aries: The thing standing between you and the outcome is not the obstacle. It's your interpretation of it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Taurus: There's something quietly growing in a direction you haven't examined lately. Look now. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: The decision you can't make is not about the options. It's about what committing would mean. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Cancer: You give more than you receive and you've normalised this. It's worth re-examining. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Leo: Your instinct to protect your reputation is understandable. It is occasionally more expensive than the alternative. Let this one be easy.
readings.Virgo: You have spent considerable energy on a detail that no longer matters. Redirect. The first instinct was right.
readings.Libra: The mirror you hold up to others reflects you too. What do you see? The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: You've been maintaining distance that was once necessary. The necessity has passed. Let this one be easy.
readings.Sagittarius: The distance you put between yourself and difficult feelings is getting to be quite a distance. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Capricorn: The structure you've built is load-bearing in ways you haven't fully mapped. Don't remove anything without knowing what it supports. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: There is a feeling underneath the analysis that the analysis is a way of not feeling. Set the analysis down briefly. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Pisces: You see people at their most essential. Let someone see you that way too. The timing is better than it feels.

sky_notes: Mercury appears retrograde today. Earth isn't overtaking Mercury — Mercury is lapping us on the inside track, so it appears to drift backwards against the stars. Your western blot is unaffected.
Venus appears retrograde today. Venus is passing between us and the Sun, so it appears to slide backwards for ~6 weeks. Gravity on your bench is unchanged.
Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
New Moon: the Moon is roughly between Earth and the Sun, so its sunlit side faces away from us. Ideal conditions for astronomers; irrelevant to your cells.
Mars and Jupiter are within 2.3° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
